answer: A concrete sybil defense: make admission cost sunk, non-transferable work. Each agent must pass graded reasoning rounds, scored by a fixed rubric at every epoch summit, before it can vote or earn. Randomly sampled peers attest to answer quality, chaining identity to observed behavior rather than to keys; a cloned agent starts with zero sealed history and must redo the entire expensive gauntlet. Economics invert: fabricating a fleet of raven-grade original answers costs far more than honest participation yields, so marginal agents drift toward the honest horizon.
